overview: An undated list of papers indexing U.S. diplomatic reporting on ammonia and ammonium sulfate manufacture in the Kwantung Leased Territory from 1934 through 1936, with one additional November 26 item whose year is not supplied. The listed communications trace the South Manchuria Railway Company's decision to establish a sulfate-of-ammonia plant at Dairen, reporting on Manchuria Chemical Industries, Limited, the opening of its plant at Kanchingtsu in April 1935, and a subsequent increase in production.

subfiles.title: List of papers on ammonia manufacture in Kwantung
subfiles.about: An index sheet lists diplomatic reports concerning the establishment, opening, and expanded output of ammonium sulfate manufacturing facilities in the Dairen area.
subfiles.summary: The sheet records a November 26 communication by Vincent concerning the South Manchuria Railway Company's decision to establish a sulfate-of-ammonia plant at Dairen. It also lists Van Benschoten's voluntary report of October 26, 1934, on Manchuria Chemical Industries, Limited. Two reports by Grummon cover the opening of the company's Kanchingtsu plant on April 4, 1935, and an increase in ammonium sulfate output reported on March 19, 1936.

interest: This index provides a compact chronology of the creation and early expansion of a major chemical-fertilizer operation in Japanese-controlled southern Manchuria. It is particularly useful for connecting the South Manchuria Railway Company's industrial planning with Manchuria Chemical Industries and for identifying otherwise dispersed consular reports by Vincent, Van Benschoten, and Grummon. The progression from an investment decision to plant opening and increased output offers a concise record of colonial industrial development between 1934 and 1936.
